methodologyNotes: Self-serve USD pricing collected from each vendor's official pricing page on 2026-06-14. Atlassian Statuspage, Sorry App (sorryapp.com), Hund, StatusPal, and Status.io prices were read directly from their official pages. Better Stack uses a per-responder-seat model with status-page add-ons (no standalone flat plan); the per-responder figure is the smallest billable unit. Instatus prices are JS-rendered and not directly readable; the starting price of $20/month (Pro) and $300/month (Business) was confirmed by two independent aggregators (GetApp, SourceForge) plus a Better Stack comparison article — noted in provenance. Freshstatus (by Freshworks) appears to be entirely free-tier only per GetApp, Capterra, and the Freshworks product site; no paid tiers are publicly listed. Quote-only/Enterprise tiers recorded as monthlyUsd: null throughout. minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, and overagePerCall are null on every plan as this is a non-telephony vertical.

Pro $20/month and Business $300/month are corroborated by Instatus's own first-party blog (instatus.com/blog/incident-io-pricing), which states 'Pro ($20/month): 50 monitors with 30-second checks, email and SMS alerts, up to 50 team members' and 'Business ($300/month): up to 1,000 monitors, phone alerts, SAML SSO, all status page types, 25,000 subscribers' — feature sets that match these plans exactly — and by the CheckStatus comparison page (checkstatus.io/compare/instatus/), which repeatedly cites the '$20/mo to $300/mo, 15x' jump. The first-party figures ($20/$300) are retained as they are directly attested by Instatus and match the listed features; the discrepancy is flagged here and in plan notes. The official pricing page is kept as the primary source URL for structure; corroboration links point to the first-party blog.
